title: DexEngine: Scaling Human Demonstrations into Physically Executable Whole-Robot Data
summary: A growing body of recent work addresses the retargeting of human hand-object demonstrations to robotic hands. To train whole-robot policies, however, the retargeted motions must be kinematically feasible and physically executable, and be produced efficiently at scale.
